summary: Build and maintain Digital Product Passport platforms for the footwear and automotive industries, and build dataspaces within the Gaia-X, Pontus-X and Catena-X ecosystems. Also set up GitLab CI/CD and monitoring across the company's projects.

Built custom systems for client companies, from their requirements through to production, and maintained existing codebases. Among them, a broadband system for Sunway University students. Done alongside a full-time degree.
